summary: Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, disclosing its monthly report and announcing a routine cash distribution of $0.086363 per trust certificate. The distribution is payable August 10, 2026, to holders of record as of August 7, 2026. This is a standard periodic distribution for a pass-through trust, not a special situation. The filing contains no M&A activity, strategic review, or corporate event. The monthly report updates portfolio status but does not trigger a special-situations category. No deal terms, advisors, or structural changes apply. This is a routine current report with no actionable event.
